resources.string: Getting Started – GPS Cam App Onboarding Flow
GPS Cam makes location-aware photography simple. Get started in seconds by automatically stamping your photos with accurate GPS data, adding notes, and reliving your memories on a map.
Hmmm, it seems like permission is missing!
Go to app setting and allow Camera, Location & Storage access permissions
Camera, Location & Storage access permissions are required by the application to function properly.
